description: ΚΥΚΛΟΦΟΡΙΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ - ΒΟΡΕΙΟ ΑΙΓΑΙΟ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΤΜΗΜΑ ΔΗΜΟΣΙΑΣ ΠΕΡΙΟΥΣΙΑΣ & ΚΡΑΤΙΚΩΝ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ - ΛΕΣΒΟΣ. VOERTUIGRELEASE - NOORD-AEGEAN VOOR DE JAAR 2014, 2015, 2016. Coverage: ΤΜΗΜΑ ΔΗΜΟΣΙΑΣ ΠΕΡΙΟΥΣΙΑΣ & ΚΡΑΤΙΚΩΝ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ - ΛΕΣΒΟΣ. The portal shows the English title as "PREMIK VOZIL - SEVERNA AEGIJA" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΤΜΗΜΑ ΔΗΜΟΣΙΑΣ ΠΕΡΙΟΥΣΙΑΣ & ΚΡΑΤΙΚΩΝ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ - ΛΕΣΒΟΣ. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Οχήματα, Παυση κυκλοφοριασ, Από μετάπτωση, Αρση. The listing shows 2026-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
